header:
# libarchive.js 2.0.2 retained original materials

This generated collection preserves the original wrapper grant and complete
known native library source-profile notices. Upstream terms, alternatives and
attributions remain independent; no single MIT or other license is elected
for the combined runtime. The conservative profiles include optional library
headers and are not a post-link inventory.

The official fixed distribution binds libarchive.wasm SHA-256
8a66066ed3ea1e6db0469ec752d8fca888a6bf737c6cff21fdbcb62241a72424.
Its floating Emscripten toolchain/ports identities remain unverified. This
collection is material retention, not source-availability or release approval.
